topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The rain's let up a bit, enough to give a man a break. Old Mrs. Thompson from next door, she swings by, looking to chat. Turns out, she's got this idea to put up a fence. Now, fences, they've always got two sides, but I can't help but feel a kind of warmth bubbling up. Mrs. T's been a good neighbor, always with a pie cooling on her windowsill or a friendly wave. A fence, it's a solid thing, a line drawn in the dirt, but it can also mean she's feeling settled, maybe seeing us as part of her little world. I tell her, "Sounds good to me, Mrs. T. Long as it don't block my view of the sunset." She smiles, and I figure, maybe this city's not all shadows and slick streets after all.
